about_the_game:
A bite sized raising simulation game. [Witch Maker] is a life simulation game where you play as Niziiro Mao, a happy go lucky Ink Mage currently working as a maid for the royal palace. She rarely does housework, but her majesty seems to be letting it slide.

Featuring a 2D anime art style, animations via Live2D, and visual novel storytelling.

You have one year to prepare yourself for your very first class change. Raise your stats by working and taking classes. Manage stress by resting, taking walks, or eating delicious food. Learn new skills by getting proficient with jobs, taking classes, or from the people you meet on walks and special events.

Don't forget to balance your income and expenses. Her majesty might be happy to give you pocket money, but the prices of classes, new equipment, and delicious food might leave you reeling. If you feel up to it, climbing the tower and knocking down its cute yet dangerous enemies can be highly profitable, just remember prepare by raising your stats and learning the right skills.

It's the first day of the year, you had a fun birthday party yesterday, and there's a knock on your door.

Currently in development for PC and Android.
